svg.title: Every public format, by family: 206 families, 4,178 formats
svg.desc: 206 families of public formats in 11 domains, 4,178 formats in all; each family is shown with its number of packs, counted from packs/. Air: ASTERIX 30, ADS-B 2, OpenSky Network REST API 2, readsb JSON 2, GDL 90 1. Land vehicles: OCPP 2.0.1 128, Waymo Open Dataset 114, CAN DBC (opendbc) 91, OCPP 1.6 78, Baidu Apollo 48, Eclipse uProtocol 33, AgGateway ADAPT 22, Tier IV (ROS 2) 13, ASAM OSI (Open Simulation Interface) 12, Autoware (ROS 2) 11, Eclipse KUKSA.val 8, Tesla Fleet Telemetry 5, AgOpenGPS 1, COVESA VSS 1, OpenXC 1. Sea: Argo floats (GDAC index, metadata JSON) 5, Maritime routes and NMEA extras (RTZ, TAG block, PUBX, AIS area notice) 4, NGA Maritime Safety Information 4, Signal K 3, AIS 2, ERDDAP tabledap 2, NMEA 2000 2, AIS binary applications of variable length 1, AIS regional binary messages (St. Lawrence Seaway, USCG PAWSS) 1, aisstream.io 1, IOOS glider DAC 1, NDBC realtime2 buoy data 1, NMEA 0183 1. Space: Space Data Standards 298, NASA GCN notices 21, CCSDS frames and packets 15, NASA cFE 10, CubeSat Space Protocol 2, CCSDS NDM/XML 1. Uncrewed systems and robots: ArduPilot DataFlash log 342, PX4 ULog 301, Cyphal (UAVCAN v1) 250, Gazebo messages (gz-msgs) 219, DroneCAN (UAVCAN v0) 133, MAVSDK (gRPC protobuf) 113, ROS 2 interface packages 62, Foxglove 48, UTM APIs (ASTM F3411 network RID, F3548) 46, Parrot ARSDK 44, Parrot ARSDK protobuf 39, MAVLink 2 14, Open-RMF (ROS 2) 13, VDA 5050 mobile robot interface 8, RC and small-UAS telemetry 4, Remote ID (ASTM F3411) 2, DRIP (RFC 9575) 1, MassRobotics AMR interoperability 1. C2 and tactical: Cursor on Target 2, goat-processors outputs 2, UCI 2, A-GRA 1, C2SIM 1, Canonical Track v2 1, DIS (IEEE 1278.1) 1, GeoTrackV1 1, NVG 1, STANAG 4676 ISR tracking 1. Sensors: NITF 2.1 32, SBP (Swift Navigation) 22, RoboSense lidar 19, Septentrio SBF 17, u-blox UBX 14, Inertial Sense 10, Ouster lidar 9, GNSS correction transport and network timing (NTRIP, NTP/NTS, PTP) 4, ISA 4, MISB local sets 4, STANAG 4607 GMTI 4, OGC SensorThings 2, OGC SWE 2, RINEX (GNSS observation and navigation files) 2, SAPIENT 2, Velodyne lidar 2, gpsd JSON 1, IGS SSR 1, Livox SDK2 1, OGC Moving Features JSON 1, OGC O&M Simple Features 1, RTCM 3 1, SBAS L1 messages 1, Unicore UNI 1. Transport: GBFS 84, Eclipse SUMO traffic simulation files 41, GTFS Schedule 31, OCPI 17, WZDx 10, Curb Data Specification 8, GOFS 8, TOMP-API 7, OSDM (railways) 5, NeTEx 4, ERTMS/ETCS (SUBSET-026) 3, GTFS Realtime 2, hafas-client 2, OpenTripPlanner GraphQL 2, ETSI ITS 1, MDS 1, TransXChange 1, Valhalla 1. IoT: ESPHome native API 143, SunSpec Modbus 112, FIWARE Smart Data Models 93, EVerest charging stack 55, ChirpStack v4 31, Meshtastic 12, OpenADR 3 7, Zigbee Cluster Library (zigbee-herdsman) 7, KNX 6, IEEE C37.118 synchrophasor (pypmu) 5, Modbus 4, Shelly Gen2+ RPC 4, OPC UA binary (NodeSet structures) 3, Tasmota 3, The Things Stack 3, BLE beacons 2, Home Assistant 2, Low-power mesh (6LoWPAN, RPL) 2, OpenMQTTGateway 2, DSMR P1 (Dutch smart meters) 1, OMA LwM2M 1, SML (Smart Message Language) 1, Sparkplug B 1. Networks: HL7 FHIR R4 146, OCSF 79, IETF packet headers 40, STIX 2.1 39, OpenConfig (RFC 7951 JSON) 24, IETF YANG data (RFC 7951 JSON) 19, Tunnelling and VPN (VXLAN-GPE, Geneve options, MPLS stack, IKEv2) 14, OpenTelemetry OTLP 12, Zeek JSON logs (scope separator _) 9, gNMI 8, IPPM active measurement (OWAMP, TWAMP, STAMP) 8, IP flow export (IPFIX, NetFlow, sFlow) 7, Media transport (MPEG-TS, SRT, RIST, WebRTC DCEP, RTP) 6, Messaging protocols (MQTT, AMQP 1.0, STUN/TURN) 4, Web transport framing (HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSocket, TLS 1.3) 4, 3GPP mobile core (GTP-U, GTPv2-C, PFCP) 3, Amateur and paging radio (AX.25, KISS, POCSAG) 3, Internet control plane (DNS message, DHCPv6 message, ICMPv6 ND) 3, QUIC (long-header packets, frames, transport parameters) 3, Remote access and file sharing (SSH, SMB2/3) 3, Routing control protocols (BMP, BFD, RPKI to Router) 3, CISA KEV catalog 2, IETF option areas 2, OpAMP 2, OpenC2 2, Prometheus remote write 2, Security event logs 2, Signalling transport (Diameter, SCTP) 2, BGP MRT 1, CACAO playbooks 1, CloudEvents 1, CVE JSON record 1, Elastic Common Schema 1, HSRP 1, MISP core format 1, OpenIOC 1.1 1, OSV vulnerability entry 1, PCEP 1, Suricata EVE JSON 1, Wi-Fi beacon frame 1. Maps, weather and alerts: OGC API 42, NWS weather.gov API 31, aviationweather.gov Data API 23, OGC JSON encodings 15, OpenAQ API 15, Overture Maps 15, OGC I3S (Indexed 3D Scene Layers) 8, USGS Water Data API 8, WMO BUFR sequences 4, Environment Agency flood monitoring 3, OGC CoverageJSON 3, Open311 GeoReport v2 3, OpenStreetMap PBF 3, Davis WeatherLink Live 2, GeoPackage geometry 2, NHC tropical cyclone status 2, USGS earthquake feed 2, WMO binary codes 2, CAP alerts 1, CityJSON 1, Garmin TCX 1, Geobuf 1, GeoJSON 1, GPX 1, KML 1, Mapbox Vector Tile 1, NASA EONET events 1, NOAA CO-OPS tides and currents 1, OGC Moving Features CSV 1, Overpass API JSON 1, STAC Item 1, WMO WCMP2 1, WMO WIS2 notification 1, WMS capabilities 1. Not shown: the 253 synthetic packs whose names start with conformance or demo-, which exercise the specification and stand for no real format.
